title: "اے شمر ذرا کچھ رحم تو کھا یہ چھوٹی زہرا ہے"
recitationId: "ye-choti-zehra-hai"
alternateTitle: "Ye Chhoti Zehra Hai"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "rtl"
kalamType: "Noha"
poet: "Mir Takallum"
reciter: "Shadman Raza"
tags: []
aliases: ["Ye Choti Zehra Hai"]
published: true
romanLyrics: |-
  Ae Shimr zara kuchh rahm to kha ye chhoti Zehra hai
  Maasum Sakina hai maasum Sakina hai
  Ae Shimr zara kuchh rahm to kha ye chhoti Zehra hai
  Naadaan hazina hai maasum Sakina hai

  Na maar ise naazoṅ se ise Shabbir ne paala hai
  Maasum Sakina hai maasum Sakina hai

  1
  Sajjad ki behna ko Ghaazi ki bhatiji ko
  Maaṅga hai kanizi meiṅ us phul si bachchi ko
  Shah ne apne sajdoṅ meiṅ jise Allah se maaṅga hai
  Maasum Sakina hai maasum Sakina hai

  2
  Daureṅge agar naaqe kis tarah se sambhlegi
  Gar raah meiṅ gir jaaye aawaaz kise degi
  Pusht-e-naaqa par kiuṅ tanha rassi se baandha hai
  Maasum Sakina hai maasum Sakina hai

  3
  Kya jurm kiya is ne kiuṅ is ko rulaata hai
  Dikhla ke ise paani mitti pe bahaata hai
  Kya teri koi aulaad nahiṅ kiuṅ zulm ye dhaata hai
  Maasum Sakina hai maasum Sakina hai

  4
  Rone na diya is ko Baba ke laashe par
  Hai nil tamaachoṅ ke maasuma ke chehre par
  Allah jaane ye is pe sitam kis baat ka badla hai
  Maasum Sakina hai maasum Sakina hai

  5
  Haaṅ ik raat sar-e-zindaaṅ Shabbir ka sar aaya
  Sar le kar godi meiṅ bachchi ne kiya nauha
  Aaṅkheṅ kholo Baba dekho ye kaun zaifa hai
  Maasum Sakina hai maasum Sakina hai

  6
  Maasum ki gardan meiṅ baandhi hai rasan aise
  Ghut jaayega dam is ka maiṅ tez chaluṅ kaise
  Ye kehta hua bimaar mera kham ho kar chalta hai
  Maasum Sakina hai maasum Sakina hai

  7
  Turbat pe Sakina ki Aabid ne kaha hoga
  Ye meri amaanat hai rakhna tu khayaal is ka
  Baba bhi nahiṅ ammu bhi nahiṅ beaas yatima hai
  Maasum Sakina hai maasum Sakina hai

  8
  Rauze pe nazar jab bhi ae Shaadmaaṅ jaati hai
  Phir qalb-e-Takallum ko ye baat rulaati hai
  Sadiyaaṅ guzri chhoti Bibi zindaan meiṅ tanha hai
  Maasum Sakina hai maasum Sakina hai
---

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/ye-chhoti-zehra-hai.md\")
original = path.read_text()
header, body = original[4:].split(\"\\n---\\n\", 1)
metadata, roman = header.split(\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\", 1)
for old, new in {
    \"Naadaan hazina\": \"Naadaan hazina\",
    \"Sajjad ki\": \"Sajjaad ki\",
    \"kanizi meiṅ\": \"kanizi mein\",
    \"sajdoṅ meiṅ\": \"sajdoṅ mein\",
    \"Daureṅge\": \"Daureṅ ge\",
    \"sambhlegi\": \"sambhle gi\",
    \"raah meiṅ\": \"raah mein\",
    \"kise degi\": \"kise de gi\",
    \"Pusht-e-naaqa\": \"Pusht-e-naaqe\",
    \"ke laashe par\": \"ke laasha par\",
    \"tamaachoṅ ke maasuma ke\": \"tamaanchoṅ ke maasum se\",
    \"godi meiṅ\": \"godi mein\",
    \"gardan meiṅ\": \"gardan mein\",
    \"jaayega\": \"jaaye ga\",
    \"maiṅ tez\": \"main tez\",
    \"kaha hoga\": \"kaha ho ga\",
    \"beaas yatima\": \"be aas yatima\",
    \"zindaan meiṅ\": \"zindaan mein\",
}.items():
    assert roman.count(old) == 1, old
    roman = roman.replace(old, new)
updated = \"---\\n\" + metadata + \"romanLyrics: |-\\n\" + roman + \"\\n---\\n\" + body
assert updated.split(\"\\n---\\n\", 1)[1] == original.split(\"\\n---\\n\", 1)[1]
assert len(roman.splitlines()) == len(body.splitlines())
for roman_line, source_line in zip(roman.splitlines(), body.splitlines()):
    assert bool(roman_line.strip()) == bool(source_line.strip())
    if source_line.isdecimal():
        assert roman_line.strip() == str(int(source_line))
assert all(c.isascii() or c in \"ṅṄ\" for c in roman)
path.write_text(updated)
PY
git diff -- src/data/lyrics/ye-chhoti-zehra-hai.md"

item.text:
Audited all 38 Roman verses in [ye-chhoti-zehra-hai.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/3/workspaces/fb46560f373e48a3b7d55639a369ba89/src/data/lyrics/ye-chhoti-zehra-hai.md) against the Urdu. Corrected source mismatches including `naaqe`, `laasha`, and `maasum se`, and standardized `main` and `mein` to house spelling.

Verified verse and stanza alignment. Only `romanLyrics` changed. Human editorial sign-off remains pending.
